# `results/`

**Owner (only this person pushes here):** **generated by scripts**: each person commits the outputs of **their own** scripts

Every number and graph in the report must come from here.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `model_comparison.csv` | one row per model (written by the harness) |
| `model_runs/` | per-model JSON logs |
| `preds/` | OOF + student-test probabilities (used by the HMM) |
| `plots/` | comparison plots, confusion matrices, loss curves |
| `optuna/` | Optuna study + trials (Sanchita) |
| `eda/` | EDA tables/plots (Patil) |
| `maps/` | Folium HTML maps (Patil) |
| `candidates_sweep.csv, hmm_comparison.csv, hmm_tuning.csv` | Monty |
